definition: Total award value represented in the final analytical dataset.

important_caveat: Multi-supplier awards are allocated equally across usable suppliers.

definition: Share of allocated supplier value represented by the top 1% of usable supplier entities.
important_caveat: Calculated only among awards with usable supplier relationships.

definition: Number of awards associated with a buyer entity.
important_caveat: Buyer entity uses buyer_key rather than raw buyer name.

definition: Total allocated award value associated with a buyer entity.
important_caveat: Award value, not actual supplier payment.
Screening indicator only; not a fraud, corruption, wrongdoing, or probability score.
High/Priority records identify a review population; they do not establish wrongdoing.
Missing method values are retained as Unknown.
Long duration alone is not evidence of a problem.

definition: Supplier relationship requiring identity/name variation review.
